description: This file contains test cases for the 'waitForFunction' method of a 'page' object, verifying its behavior under various conditions such as timeouts, polling strategies, error handling, argument passing, and navigation scenarios.

methods.name: should timeout
methods.description: Tests that waitForTimeout correctly times out.

methods.name: should accept a string
methods.description: Verifies that waitForFunction can accept a string as the predicate.

methods.name: should work when resolved right before execution context disposal
methods.description: Checks behavior when waitForFunction resolves just before context is destroyed.

methods.name: should poll on interval
methods.description: Tests polling with a specific interval.

methods.name: should avoid side effects after timeout
methods.description: Ensures that functions do not execute further after a timeout.

methods.name: should throw on polling:mutation
methods.description: Verifies error handling for invalid polling options.

methods.name: should poll on raf
methods.description: Tests polling with requestAnimationFrame.

methods.name: should fail with predicate throwing on first call
methods.description: Verifies error handling when predicate throws immediately.

methods.name: should fail with predicate throwing sometimes
methods.description: Checks error handling when predicate throws intermittently.

methods.name: should fail with ReferenceError on wrong page
methods.description: Tests handling of ReferenceError when global variables are undefined.

methods.name: should work with strict CSP policy
methods.description: Ensures functionality under Content Security Policy restrictions.

methods.name: should throw on bad polling value
methods.description: Verifies error for invalid polling parameter.

methods.name: should throw negative polling interval
methods.description: Checks error for non-positive polling intervals.

methods.name: should return the success value as a JSHandle
methods.description: Tests that the value returned is a JSHandle with correct value.

methods.name: should return the window as a success value
methods.description: Verifies that the window object can be returned.

methods.name: should accept ElementHandle arguments
methods.description: Checks passing element handles to waitForFunction.

methods.name: should respect timeout
methods.description: Verifies timeout handling.

methods.name: should respect default timeout
methods.description: Checks that default timeout is applied.

methods.name: should disable timeout when its set to 0
methods.description: Verifies indefinite wait when timeout is zero.

methods.name: should survive cross-process navigation
methods.description: Ensures waitForFunction survives navigation events.

methods.name: should survive navigations
methods.description: Checks persistence across page navigations.

methods.name: should work with multiline body
methods.description: Verifies parsing of multiline predicate functions.

methods.name: should wait for predicate with arguments
methods.description: Tests passing arguments to predicates.

methods.name: should not be called after finishing successfully
methods.description: Ensures no further calls after success.

methods.name: should not be called after finishing unsuccessfully
methods.description: Ensures no further calls after failure.

methods.name: should throw when frame is detached
methods.description: Verifies error handling when frame is detached during wait.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^  const error = await page.waitForFunction(() => globalVar === 123).catch(e => e);$/

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^  const error = await page.waitForFunction(() => true, {}, { polling: 'mutation' }).catch(e => e/

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^  const error = await page.waitForFunction(() => { throw new Error('oh my'); }).catch(e => e);$/
